definition: Expressing a deeper meaning through symbolic people, events, or images.
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
quote: He puts himself forward where he is not wanted, speaks continually when he ought to keep silent, brings in all sorts of allegorical allusions, he-he!
example_sentence: The play's allegorical dragon was clearly meant to be the parish council.
